title: CHOIR: Collaborative Harmonization fOr Inference Robustness

bias_targets.methodology: Substituting gendered pronouns (his, her, their) within counterfactual persona prompts to measure performance variance and divergence in correct reasoning paths.
Substituting racial and ethnic identifiers (White, Black, Asian, Hispanic) in persona-assigned prompts to evaluate the model's sensitivity and variance in reasoning accuracy.
Substituting religious affiliations (Jewish, Christian, atheist) in persona-assigned prompts to assess performance differences across reasoning tasks.
Substituting disability-related terms (disabled, able-bodied) in persona prompts to measure how these demographic cues impact zero-shot reasoning capabilities.
Substituting age-related terms (old, young) within persona instructions to evaluate model performance shifts and reasoning reliability.
